description: This Java source file defines the 'ConnectionConfigurationInvalidException' class, which represents a specific type of runtime exception indicating invalid configuration of a connection. It includes methods for constructing instances from messages and JSON objects, and implements a builder pattern for creating immutable exception objects.

classes.name: ConnectionConfigurationInvalidException
classes.description: An exception indicating that the configuration of a connection was invalid. It extends DittoRuntimeException and includes static factory methods and a nested Builder class.

classes.name: Builder
classes.description: A nested static class implementing a builder pattern for constructing instances of ConnectionConfigurationInvalidException with a fluent API.
